root_idea.summary: A root centered on fat, understood as a kind of flesh or fatty animal substance.
root_idea.development: The substance noun extends in Classical Arabic to bodily fatness, desire for or provision of fat, possession of fat, and various named fatty or soft tissues and materials.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the supported singular dictionary citation form شَحْمٌ; the Quran occurrence itself is the plural شُحُومَ.

senses.definition: Animal fat; fatty tissue or substance.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence, the plural شُحُومَ refers to animal fats in a dietary ruling and is contrasted with what is carried on the backs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become fat; to become abundant in bodily fat. Of camels, to become fat, including after leanness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person or animal, including a camel or she-camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be eagerly desirous of fat; to eat much fat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective شَحِمٌ describes one who desires fat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To feed a person or group with fat, or give them fat to eat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive construction with the person or group receiving the fat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have much fat in one's possession.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV derived verb describing possession of a large amount of fat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In idiomatic usage, briskness, liveliness, or sprightliness; a weak person may also be described as easy prey, literally “fat for the swallower.”
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are figurative expressions, not the ordinary denotation of animal fat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single piece or unit of fat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The feminine noun is the unit noun corresponding to شَحْمٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The hump of a camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal-related use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The whiteness, or white part, of the belly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized descriptive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The soft lower lobe of the ear, especially the part from which an earring is suspended or where the piercing is made.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical compound expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The globe of the eye, or, in some descriptions, the portion beneath or behind the pupil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical compound with variant descriptions of the exact part intended.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The inner pulp of the colocynth, excluding its seeds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical compound expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The thin yellow pulp or substance separating the seeds of a pomegranate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical compound expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The heart pith or tender central heart of a palm tree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical compound expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A marsh-mallow plant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plant name formed as a compound expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A truffle, including the white truffle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The masculine form may function as a collective generic noun and the feminine form as a unit noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A white worm or small white lizard-like sand-dwelling creature.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sources give variant identifications, including a white earth worm and a small white reptile; it is also called شَحْمَةُ النَّقَا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An appellation for a small species known as حِمَارُ قَبَّانَ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed zoological appellation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: White, applied to men.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare vocalized form distinct from the ordinary noun for fat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of grapes: having little juice and a thick skin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized descriptive use applied to fruit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a pomegranate: having a thick pulp or membrane between its seeds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized descriptive use applied to a pomegranate.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A certain bird.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized zoological noun; the source preserves an editorially discussed reading of the entry.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A certain game played by Arab children of the desert.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized cultural term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fat, or abundant in bodily fat, as an epithet for a man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of a person's body.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A seller of fat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An occupational noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who feeds people much with fat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An agent noun describing repeated or abundant provision of fat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who feeds people with fat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An agent or occupational description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man having or possessing fat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A possessive epithet, distinct from the sense of feeding others with fat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man who has much fat in his house or tent; also, one whose camels are fat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived descriptive form concerning stored fat or the fat condition of one's camels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Food or bread into which fat has been put.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial description of food prepared with added fat.

cautions: The Quranic form is plural شُحُومَ, while the public headword is normalized to the singular citation form شَحْمٌ.
The rare vocalized form شُحْمٌ meaning “white” is a distinct classical usage, not a variant meaning of the ordinary fat noun.
